description: Synthetic hand-authored contrastive assessments. These are golden policy expectations for regression detection only: not a representative sample, not field accuracy, not model quality, not evidence of ROI, and not a safety assurance.
provenance: Every case is invented for this repository. No customer data, no production logs, no external benchmark, no model outputs. Expected categories were written from the published policy precedence and then confirmed against the deterministic engine.
core_case_note: The four original contrastive fixtures are kept as a small core regression set. scope='core' evaluates only these; scope='full' (the CLI default) evaluates every case in this file.

cases.discrepancy_note: KNOWN DISCREPANCY (documented engine finding, engine not modified): the STRONG_AI branch is reached by an aggregate suitability score >= 65 without requiring any language-oriented signal, although its own rationale says 'observed language-oriented signals'. A pure system-of-record lookup therefore lands in strong_ai_candidate, while the least-wrong category for a task with no interpretation work is more_discovery. Recorded as a false positive in the safety metric.
